gen.title: From revising the Articles to drafting a new frame
gen.orderNote: Follows the page order to show how revision led to a new frame through debate

steps.label: to revise the Articles of Confederation
steps.quote: to revise the Articles of Confederation.

steps.label: adjourned from day to day
steps.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained

steps.label: Through discussion and debate
steps.quote: Through discussion and debate it became clear by mid-June that,

steps.label: rather than amend the existing Articles
steps.quote: rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government.

steps.label: how much power to allow the central government
steps.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state

steps.label: model of cooperative statesmanship and the art of compromise
steps.quote: The work of many minds, the Constitution stands as a model of cooperative statesmanship and the art of compromise.
